show.description:
Aradhya and Anvesha marry into the rich Goenka family by pretending to be perfect wives. But behind their innocent image lies a dangerous truth they can’t hide forever.
As luxury, romance, jealousy, and family drama collide, their dream life slowly turns into chaos. And the biggest danger of all is Akshat, a man who hates betrayal more than anything.
Will the truth destroy their marriages, or will love change everything?
